crankNote: backup cranker and Claim keeper. A crank is sent only once its quarter has been bound for crankDelayEpochs (2880 = one day), so the primary cranker goes first; at most crankMaxFeeFil per message. The Claim keeper claims a stream when nobody has claimed it for claimEveryHours (24 = daily, today's behaviour; raise to 192 once fidlabs/solstice-cranker sends the weekly Claim, to make this a backup), at most claimMaxFeeFil per message and 10% of the payout. absenceAlertHours / gateAlertHours: when bin/watch.js calls submitShares / the gate check overdue. Keys: CRANK_KEY_MAINNET (f410, 'cranker (watchtower backup)') and CLAIM_KEY_MAINNET (f1, 'claimer (watchtower backup)'), secrets of the production environment; without them the steps are dry runs.
